detail: Full summary: Gate tuning observation from live dogfooding: the activity marker arms on ANY Edit/Write while the session cwd is in the project — including writes to files outside the project root (this firing was triggered by ~/.claude memory-directory writes only). Harmless direction (over-asks rather than under-asks) and recording is cheap, but if field feedback shows noise, the marker hook could compare the tool_input file_path against the project root before arming. Leaving as-is until there's evidence it annoys.
